==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
A possible loan relation with Indo-European {{m|ine-pro||*ḱr̥h₂-nó-s|horn}} (from {{m|ine-pro|*ḱerh₂-||horn, head}}) has been suggested, but the direction of loaning is disputed. Alternatively suggested to be cognate with a {{cog|omv-pro|*ḳar-||horn}}, from {{der|sem-pro|afa-pro|*ḳar-||horn}} (tentative reconstructions).<ref>{{R:HSED|*ḳar-|passage=1549. *ḳar- “horn”}}</ref> Despite Orel and Stolbova’s connection with a supposed {{cog|egy|qrtj||horns|pos=dual}}, however, the Egyptian word is properly {{m|egy|krtj}} and cannot correspond to the Semitic. Militarev and Kogan suggest an original {{m|sem-pro||*ḳar-n-}}, pointing to Tigre {{m|tig|ቀር|tr=qär}} and similar Ethiopian Semitic forms with no trace of the {{m|sem-pro||*-n}}, and refer to Dolgopolsky for the Afroasiatic, Kartvelian and Indo-European comparisons.<ref>{{R:sem-pro:SED|volume=I|id=29|entry=*ḳarn-}}</ref>
